extracted.intended_audience: freelance humor/satire writers (especially those knowledgeable about punk/music) seeking to pitch to The Hard Times
extracted.subtask_short: pitching satire to The Hard Times
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for freelance satirical writers on how to pitch and what types of pieces The Hard Times accepts (particularly music/punk-themed satire and shorter joke lists). Explains required submission materials, contact, and what the editors look for.

rubrics_metrics.name: Knowledge of the punk scene, subculture, and relatable topics
rubrics_metrics.description: What we like to see is a knowledge of the punk scene, subculture, and topics that our audience can relate to.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Demonstrate familiarity with punk/music culture and choose topics the Hard Times audience will recognize and find relatable. This is the central content-quality criterion for pitches.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submit five satire headlines
rubrics_metrics.description: Send us 5 satire headlines and if we like what we see we will add you to our pitch group and you can start writing for us.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a packet containing five distinct satire headline ideas; selection by editors leads to addition to the pitch group and the opportunity to write. The wording implies editors evaluate headline humor and fit before commissioning full pieces.

rubrics_metrics.name: Send pitches to ideas@thehardtimes.net
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Email is the submission channel. Include the 5-headline packet in that message. No alternative submission mechanism is described.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multiple submissions and persistence encouraged
rubrics_metrics.description: Don’t be afraid to send multiple submissions if you don’t hear back the first time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Because the site receives many pitches, applicants should feel free to follow up or resend additional packets rather than relying on a single submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Make your pitch stand out
rubrics_metrics.description: We get a lot of pitches so sometimes it can be tough to stand out from the pack.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Editors expect originality and distinctiveness; while no explicit formula is given, implicit advice is to craft memorable, clearly on-brand satire that differentiates you from other submitters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pitch shorter joke list ideas (concise lists preferred)
rubrics_metrics.description: We’ve also begun posting more joke lists... And we want to get more of those ideas, but shorter (these ones are super long). Pitch us some of those too!
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples of existing long-form lists are provided (e.g., '100 Band Logos Ranked by How Much Better We Think They Are Than the Mona Lisa', 'Every Boss Pedal and Which Band Its Owners Desperately Wish They Were In', '50 Famous Lead Singers Ranked by How Good of a Roommate I Think They’d Be'). When pitching listicle-style humor, aim for shorter, punchier lists rather than extremely long pieces.
